articles.title: McTominay stars in Napoli draw that leaves Allegri ‘not lucid enough’ to talk
articles.description: Gli Azzurri show positive signs of improvement in seesaw 3-3 draw against a Roma side inspired by Messi-like Matías Soulé Scott McTominay was leaving nothing to doubt. He appeared to have scored with a close-range header early in the second half of Napoli’s game at home to Roma, but Pierluigi Gollini clawed the ball out from inside the goal. McTominay got his noggin to the rebound, nudging it back across the line. Roma’s keeper pushed away again, so the Napoli midfielder got to his feet and smashed a shot into the back of the net. Just typical. You wait two months for your first goal of the Serie A season, then three show up at once. articles.title: Mark Daigneault On Jalen Williams' Injury: 'We're Not Doing Great'
articles.description: The Oklahoma City Thunder had no updates on Jalen Williams' condition after Williams' suffered a serious leg injury on Sunday against the Los Angeles Clippers. "We're not doing great," said head coach Mark Daigneault, who added that the team will be briefed on Monday. Williams landed awkwardly after getting fouled while going for a lay-up. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander teared up while addressing the injury following the game. "I just feel bad for him," Gilgeous-Alexander said. "It's obviously going to be tough without a player like that. But he's not gone forever. He'll be back better than ever, and we know it. We've just got to hold the fort down until he comes back." Williams missed 49 games last season due to hamstring and wrist issues. Cason Wallace and Jaylin Williams also left the game and did not return.
